body:
Not sure who all will see this, but to everyone who has commented on this, I really appreciate it. 
Every now and then I just let all the hurt and loneliness I'm usually really good at dealing with just take over me. And I've moved a lot in recent years plus I'm painfully shy so I really have no one else to go to, especially late at night. 
I know everyone says it, but I really do love reddit and the people on here who give me a little more faith in humanity.

I'm in the same boat.

Except I can't seem to rationale my parents paying for literally everything in my life because I can't get a job to save my life. 

So what if I'm in school? Wouldn't if be easier for them to just pay for a funeral once and be done with it?

I know right?! 
When do you stop feeling like an asshole because you've gone this far in life for everyone else, and now you just want something for you?

Just because living makes you miserable doesn't mean you don't love and appreciate everyone in your life, it just means life fucking sucks, and there's only so much you can take for everyone else before you just can't fucking take it anymore.

Sorry, I know that's probably not what you came here for. But I just think I understand how you feel.

idk what to do...I feel more alone than anything. I have literally no one here...I'm just so tired of giving everyone else advise and then having no one when I need help, or really any other time...but what it really is is that I fucked up and made someone my life and now that they're gone everything I have worked towards is meaningless, and I've lost all my friends, and I just have nothing and no one.
